name: Earth Ear
body:
School divination; Level druid 2, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Area 100-ft. radius
Duration 1 round/caster level

DESCRIPTION

You place your ear to the ground in an effort to determine the location and size of creatures moving above or beneath the surface of the ground.

With a successful Perception check (DC 15 + 1 per 5 feet of distance) you can determine the size, distance and direction of creatures walking on the ground or traveling beneath it due to the vibrations they create. A separate Perception check is required for each creature.
